text.title: PR Mentoring Session Protocol — Worked Example
text.summary: One complete session record for a junior's second attempt at a re-runnable migration (one goal, gap anchored to line 18, six labelled comments with one praise, the junior's restatement and fix commit, prior record linked with streak 2, follow-up PR named and landed) with a note on each non-obvious value, then the same session written as a trait review and what the validator prints.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: swe:bohdan opens PR #412 in acme/billing with migration 0042 that runs an unguarded `ALTER TABLE`. The prior session (2026-08-26) named the same goal and its follow-up PR #398 showed the same gap, so this is the second `not-demonstrated`. swe:alice reviews on 2026-09-09; the follow-up PR #420 lands eight days later with every ALTER guarded.

example.title: bohdan, session 2026-09-09
example.note: `learning_goal` is one behaviour the next migration PR can show; it is the same goal as the prior record because that goal is still `not-demonstrated` (r-one-observable-learning-goal, r-progression-linked-to-prior-session). `observed_gap.did` names the file, the line and what the code does; the first `evidence[]` URL is the `#discussion_r` anchor (r-observed-gap-cites-diff-line). Six labelled comments, two of them nits, one praise on the transaction wrapper bohdan got right; nits do not outnumber the rest, so the outcome is `learning_goal_addressed` (r-comments-labelled-with-counts). `restated_gap` is bohdan's sentence and the fix commit is his (r-junior-restates-and-writes-the-fix). The unused import is a deferred finding posted after the session, not mixed into it (r-session-scoped-to-one-pr-and-goal). The streak is 2, so no escalation yet; the follow-up is a behaviour with a 14-day window, PR #420 landed inside it, and the record is `closed` (r-follow-up-is-a-named-next-pr). `evaluation_use` was stated at creation and bohdan confirmed the text in an issue comment (r-record-shared-with-junior).

example.title: the same session as a trait review
example.note: What the validator prints: `learning_goal` contains "be more careful" and "think about" (r-one-observable-learning-goal); `observed_gap.did` contains "rushed" and "sloppy" (r-observed-gap-cites-diff-line); `comment_counts.praise` is 0 (r-comments-labelled-with-counts); `prior_record_url` set with no `prior_action_status` (r-progression-linked-to-prior-session); `follow_up_action` is "keep this in mind next time" and `window` 30 exceeds 14 (r-follow-up-is-a-named-next-pr); no `evidence[]` URL is a line anchor; cross-field: `fix_commit.author` is the senior (fm-senior-rewrites-the-code), 14 nitpicks against 1 other comment with `session_outcome: learning_goal_addressed` (fm-nit-storm), streak 3 with no `escalation`, and `status: closed` with `demonstrate_in.url` null (fm-follow-up-never-checked). What the junior sees: a note about being rushed with nothing to open and fix, and the senior's commit on their branch.
